provenance.encoder: generate-storage-v1.mjs; independent fixed-offset big-endian encoder and Node SHA-384; no production imports
provenance.scope: Structural encoding and caller-bind expectation vectors only. SHA-384 records integrity of encoded bytes, not authenticity, freshness, verified leaf presence, persistence, durability, serving authority, or authorization.
provenance.bitmap: 4096 bytes = 32768 LSB-first bits; raw bitmaps below are candidate payload bytes. A set bit is not itself evidence that a leaf was verified or persisted.

identity_vectors.note: Class 0 pairs only with representation 0 and key epoch 0.
Class 1 pairs with representation 1; epoch zero is valid and does not imply decryption.
Ciphertext class preserves the QBS-05 u32 key epoch.
Logical length zero has zero bitmap pages; this is fixed-wire identity encoding only.
32769 leaves require pages 0 and 1; final page contains one in-range bit.

valid_checkpoints.note: One-leaf plaintext identity, page 0 all-zero bitmap. This is only an encoded candidate record; it does not claim the leaf is durably present.
valid_checkpoints.trust: UntrustedCheckpoint/ResumeHint only; bytes do not establish authenticity, freshness, presence, durability, or authority.

valid_checkpoints.note: Page 1 of 32769 leaves; bit 0 set, all other bits zero. The final page has one in-range leaf and 32767 unused tail bits.
valid_checkpoints.trust: UntrustedCheckpoint/ResumeHint only; bytes do not establish authenticity, freshness, presence, durability, or authority.

malformed_identity_vectors.note: Final reserved bytes must be zero.
Private plaintext class is unsupported in phase A.
Logical length exceeds the QBS-05 1 TiB ceiling.

malformed_checkpoint_vectors.note: 399 bytes; checkpoint must be exactly 400 bytes.
401 bytes; checkpoint must be exactly 400 bytes.
Reserved header bytes must be zero.
Reserved page bytes must be zero.
Reserved sequence-tail bytes must be zero.
SHA-384 over bytes 0..352 does not match.
Declared payload length is not 4096; prefix digest was recomputed.

bind_refusal_vectors.note: Checkpoint identity differs from the caller-expected full 256-byte identity by storage_generation.
Checkpoint page 0 does not equal caller-expected page 1.
Empty entries have zero bitmap pages; the checkpoint decoder rejects page 0 during geometry admission.
A one-leaf entry has only page 0; the checkpoint decoder rejects page 1 during geometry admission.
Supplied exact 4096-byte bitmap differs from checkpoint commitment.
Bitmap payload must be exactly 4096 bytes.
With one in-range bit, any other bit in this final page is unused and must be zero; checkpoint digest is valid for these bytes.
